versions.content: Service Name Eth_MacSecAddRxSa (draft) Syntax Std_ReturnType Eth_MacSecAddRxSa ( uint8 CtrlIdx, uint8 An, uint64 LowestPn, uint32 Ssci, const Mka_SakKeyPtrType * KeysPtr, boolean Active ) Service ID [hex] 0x30 Sync/Async Asynchronous Reentrancy Reentrant for different CtrlIdx, non reentrant for the same CtrlIdx CtrlIdx Index of the Ethernet controller within the context of Ethernet Driver An Association Number to use in the MACsec’s reception secure association LowestPn Next accepted Packet Number in the MACsec’s reception secure association Ssci Short Secure Channel Identifiert used in the MACsec’s reception secure association KeysPtr Pointer to the SAKs Key (and needed Key information) to use in the MACsec’s reception secure association Parameters (in) Active Boolean to enable/disable the MACsec’s reception secure association Parameters (inout) None Parameters (out) None Return value Std_ReturnType E_OK : The request has been accecpted E_NOT_OK : The request has been rejected ▽ △ Description Requests the Ethernet Controller Driver to create a Reception Secure Association in the Controller. The Short Secure Channel Identifier is included to support XPN configurations. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via Eth.h
